steps.description: Fetch the list of stock tickers to be compared
Retrieve trading data for each stock ticker including price values over a specified time period
Calculate the minimum price value for each stock within the retrieved trading data
Compute the price differences for each stock over the specified time period
Compare the tickers, minimum values, and price differences across the selected stocks
